messages.subject: cumulative distributions for several groups
parts:
Hello,

I want to show the cumulative distribution functions of several groups
within one plot. When I use the geom_step function the lines get
connected between different groups. Is there a way to avoid this? I
want geom_step behaving the same way as geom_line. Here's an example:

x <- sort(rnorm(47))
df1<-data.frame(y=x,x=seq_along(x),z='A')
x <- sort(rnorm(47))
df2<-data.frame(y=x,x=seq_along(x),z='B')
df <-rbind(df1,df2)
qplot(data=df,x=x,y=y,colour=z)+geom_step() #lines get scrambled
qplot(data=df,x=x,y=y,colour=z)+geom_line() #lines from different
groups are separated

Thanks a lot!
